name: Korean Ghost Stories
description: A series of 8 one-act dramas. It is the continuation of a classic series of ghost stories which aired first on KBS between 1977 and 1989 and later between 1996 and 1999. This marks the return of the series after nine years.

videos.title: Nine-Tailed Fox
videos.overview: For over 400 years, the Lee family has upheld a clandestine ritual to prevent the emergence of the gumiho. However, their efforts are threatened when an individual transformed into a gumiho sets out to seek vengeance.

videos.title: Let’s Head to Cheongsan, My Dear
videos.overview: The sole daughter of the Han family, Yeon Hwa, is gravely ill with a mysterious disease and faces imminent death. According to the shaman Dangol's family, her only chance of survival lies in consuming the living liver of an infant...

videos.title: Curse of the Sajin Sword
videos.overview: When a mysterious murder takes place in the village where the royal treasure sword, known as the sajin sword, is being forged, police investigator Yun In and shaman Mu Ryeong are sent to the scene to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Demon Book
videos.overview: fter the sudden death of Injong, strange fatalities begin to plague the palace one after another. Sa Hyeon, the head of the Royal Guards and a childhood friend of Injong, investigates the mysteries behind these unsettling occurrences.

videos.title: Master of the Five Paths
videos.overview: In a village where the living and the dead coexist in a state of madness, an exorcist uncovers hidden secrets, one by one, to guide the souls of the departed and bring purification to the village.

videos.title: Gibang Horror Story
videos.overview: In the village of Hwahonok, word is buzzing about a ghost that might be haunting the place. With the magistrate facing some bad luck, Kim Dae Gam steps in to take control of the district.

videos.title: Tale of the Grim Reaper
videos.overview: On a special mission from King Yeom Ra, the grim reaper Kim Sa Sin must locate the missing register before the next passage to the afterlife opens.

videos.title: Woman Who Returns Home
videos.overview: On her wedding day to Jeon Gyul, Su Yeon is forcibly taken by soldiers. Upon her return to her hometown, she faces accusations of being a "returnee woman" and must confront the difficulties posed by her in-laws.
